leftOperands.name: http:path
leftOperands.description: Returns the path from the http-request(without host and query-elements).

leftOperands.name: http:bodyValue
leftOperands.description: Returns the value from the requested element in the http-body. Requires the body to be in json-format

leftOperands.name: vc:role
leftOperands.description: Retrieves the role from a verifiable credential for the organization running the PAP. Role needs to be contained in the json as roles[{target:id, names:[role1,role2]}]

leftOperands.name: vc:currentParty
leftOperands.description: Returns the current party, e.g. the issuer of the provided credential.

leftOperands.name: vc:type
leftOperands.description: Returns the type of the provided credential.

leftOperands.name: ngsi-ld:entityType
leftOperands.description: Returns the entity-type from an ngsi-ld request, either from the path or the request body.

leftOperands.name: ngsi-ld:entityTypeGroup
leftOperands.description: Returns the entity-type from an ngsi-ld request, either from the path or the request body.

leftOperands.name: odrl:dateTime
leftOperands.description: Returns the current time(taken from the Open-Policy-Agent system-time).

leftOperands.name: odrl:dayOfWeek
leftOperands.description: Returns the day of week from the current time(taken from the Open-Policy-Agent system-time).

leftOperands.name: odrl:hourOfDay
leftOperands.description: Returns the hour of day from the current time(taken from the Open-Policy-Agent system-time).

leftOperands.name: dome-op:role
leftOperands.description: Retrieves the role from a verifiable credential for the organization running the PAP. Role needs to be contained in the json as roles[{target:id, names:[role1,role2]}]

leftOperands.name: dome-op:currentParty
leftOperands.description: Returns the current party, e.g. the issuer of the provided credential.

leftOperands.name: dome-op:relatedParty
leftOperands.description: Returns the related party from the targeted TMForum Entity. Retrieves the entity from the request's target.

leftOperands.name: dome-op:owner
leftOperands.description: Returns the related party with role `Owner` from the list of related parties.

leftOperands.name: dome-op:relatedParty_role
leftOperands.description: Returns the role of the related party.

leftOperands.name: dome-op:validFor_startDateTime
leftOperands.description: Returns the start of validity for a given entity.

leftOperands.name: dome-op:validFor_endDateTime
leftOperands.description: Returns the end of validity for a given entity.

leftOperands.name: tmf:lifecycleStatus
leftOperands.description: Returns the current lifeCycleStatus for a requested TMF-Entity.

leftOperands.name: tmf:resource
leftOperands.description: Returns the type for a requested TMF-Resource.

leftOperands.name: ovc:leftOperand
leftOperands.description: Retrieves the claim from the incoming Verifiable Credential by its Json-Path.

leftOperands.name: json:payloadValue
leftOperands.description: Extracts a value from the JSON payload at a given dot-notation path (e.g., $.my.field).

leftOperands.name: json:subjectValue
leftOperands.description: Extracts a value from the subject/identity object at a given dot-notation path.

leftOperands.name: json:payloadType
leftOperands.description: Returns the type field from the JSON payload.

leftOperands.name: dspace:membershipType
leftOperands.description: Retrieves the membershipType from a MembershipCredential in the verifiable credentials.

leftOperands.name: dspace:scope
leftOperands.description: Retrieves the scope from the payload.

leftOperands.name: dspace:participant
leftOperands.description: Retrieves the participant from the payload.

rightOperands.name: odrl:policyUsage
rightOperands.description: Returns the current-time, e.g. the time that the policy is evaluated at.

rightOperands.name: dome-op:currentParty
rightOperands.description: Returns the current party, e.g. the issuer of the provided credential.

operators.name: http:isInPath
operators.description: Checks the path of http-requests. Returns true, if the leftOperand is a sub-path(or equal) of the rightOperand

operators.name: odrl:eq
operators.description: Checks that both operands are equal.

operators.name: odrl:hasPart
operators.description: Checks that the rightOperand is a sub-set of the leftOperand.

operators.name: odrl:gt
operators.description: Checks that the leftOperand is greater than the rightOperand.

operators.name: odrl:gteq
operators.description: Checks that the leftOperand is greater or equal than the rightOperand.

operators.name: odrl:isAllOf
operators.description: Checks that both sets are equal.

operators.name: odrl:isAnyOf
operators.description: Checks that leftOperand is contained in the rightOperand's set.

operators.name: odrl:anyOf
operators.description: Checks that leftOperand is contained in the rightOperand's set.

operators.name: odrl:isNoneOf
operators.description: Checks that leftOperand is not contained in the rightOperand's set.

operators.name: odrl:isPartOf
operators.description: Checks that rightOperand is contained in the leftOperand's set.

operators.name: odrl:lt
operators.description: Checks that the leftOperand is lesser than the rightOperand.

operators.name: odrl:lteq
operators.description: Checks that the leftOperand is lesser or equal than the rightOperand.

operators.name: odrl:neq
operators.description: Checks that both operands are not equal.

operators.name: odrl:regex
operators.description: Checks that the leftOperand matches the regular expression provided in the rightOperand.

constraints.name: ovc:constraint
constraints.description: Checks that all included constraints are true.

constraints.name: ovc:credentialSubjectType
constraints.description: Checks that the provided Verifiable Credentials subject type is equal to the provided one.

operands.name: odrl:and
operands.description: Requires that all given constraints evaluate to  true.

operands.name: odrl:andSequence
operands.description: Requires that all given constraints evaluate to  true.

operands.name: odrl:or
operands.description: Requires that at least one of the given constraints evaluates to true.

operands.name: odrl:xone
operands.description: Requires that exactly one of the given constraints evaluates to true.

assignees.name: odrl:assignee
assignees.description: Is the incoming User-ID the same as the given ID.

assignees.name: vc:any
assignees.description: Allows access for any requesting user.

assignees.name: json:assignee
assignees.description: Checks if the subject in the JSON payload matches the given ID.

assignees.name: json:any
assignees.description: Allows access for any requesting user in a JSON evaluation context.

actions.name: odrl:modify
actions.description: Checks if the given http-request is a modification(e.g. of type PATCH).

actions.name: odrl:delete
actions.description: Checks if the given http-request is a deletion(e.g. of type DELETE).

actions.name: odrl:read
actions.description: Checks if the given http-request is a read(e.g. of type GET).

actions.name: odrl:use
actions.description: Checks if the given http-request is a general usage(e.g. of type DELETE/GET/POST/PUT/PATCH).

actions.name: dome-op:modify
actions.description: Checks if the given http-request is a general usage(e.g. of type DELETE/GET/POST/PUT/PATCH).

actions.name: dome-op:write
actions.description: Checks if the given http-request is a write request(e.g. of type DELETE/GET/POST/PUT/PATCH).

actions.name: dome-op:read
actions.description: Checks if the given http-request is a read(e.g. of type GET).

actions.name: dome-op:create
actions.description: Checks if the given http-request is a creation(e.g. of type POST).

actions.name: tmf:create
actions.description: Checks if the given http-request is a creation(e.g. of type POST).

actions.name: ngsild:create
actions.description: Checks if the given http-request is a creation(e.g. of type POST).

actions.name: json:read
actions.description: Checks if the action field in the JSON payload indicates a read operation.

actions.name: json:write
actions.description: Checks if the action field in the JSON payload indicates a write operation.

actions.name: json:create
actions.description: Checks if the action field in the JSON payload indicates a create operation.

actions.name: json:delete
actions.description: Checks if the action field in the JSON payload indicates a delete operation.

actions.name: json:use
actions.description: Checks if the action field in the JSON payload indicates any usage operation.

actions.name: dspace:read
actions.description: Allows if the request scope is not a contract negotiation or transfer process.

targets.name: odrl:uid
targets.description: Checks that the request target is equal to the given id.

targets.name: odrl:target
targets.description: Checks that the request target is equal to the given id.

targets.name: json:uid
targets.description: Checks that the target field in the JSON payload is equal to the given id.

targets.name: json:target
targets.description: Checks that the target field in the JSON payload is equal to the given id.

targets.name: json:payloadTarget
targets.description: Checks that a target extracted from a dot-notation path in the JSON payload is equal to the given id.
